lemma: Dießen a. Ammersee, ehem. Augustiner-Chorherrenstiftskirche Mariä Himmelfahrt

bld.route_reason: No deckenmalerei.eu building for this lemma. Wikidata 'Marienmünster Dießen, Kirchengebäude in Dießen am Ammersee': the former Augustinian canons' church; its existing parts include Bergmüller's frescoes Q127502516 and Q106548750 and the fresco Q104218325 'Gründung des Klosters St. Georgen durch den seligen Rathardus', i.e. the article's B, D and C. Place, dedication and contents agree.

_:person:johann-michael-fischer.route_reason: Johann Michael Fischer (1692–1766), German Baroque architect; Dießen (from 1732) is one of his known churches; dates fit.

_:person:herkulan-karg.route_reason: Herkulan Karg, Propst (P106) with GND 1166337499 and a deckenmalerei.eu ID; the article names him Propst of Dießen.

_:person:johann-georg-bergmueller.route_reason: Johann Georg Bergmüller (1688–1762), Augsburg fresco painter and academy director, as the article says; the existing fresco items B and D already name him.
